items.t: SpaceX Wraps Up $32 Billion of AI Chip Debt at Yields Topping 8%
items.d: SpaceX’s $32 billion debt deal to fund its access to artificial intelligence chips may serve as a blueprint for similar transactions as the next wave of financing tied to the artificial intelligence boom gets underway. It is likely going to be costly for the companies borrowing.

items.t: New Space Simulator Allows Researchers to Visit Moon and Mars
items.d: Texas A&M University is giving students and scientists the chance to experience what it’s like to walk on the moon and mars with its new space simulator and it could be a game changer for the future of space exploration. NBC’s Ryan Chandler shares a first look for TODAY.

items.t: How the U.S. military is using high-powered microwave systems to stop drone attacks
items.d: As drone warfare increasingly becomes the norm in global conflicts from Iran to Ukraine, the U.S. military is using high-powered microwave systems as a new line of defense. NBC News’ Courtney Kube takes a look at the new technology that can knock out dozens of drones at once. Correction: A previous version of this story included the wrong title for Mike Dodd.
